## What does this change?

## Type
- [ ] New source
- [ ] New or changed dataset
- [ ] New or changed analysis
- [ ] New or changed infographic
- [ ] Shared code, tests, tools or documentation

## Checklist
- [ ] Source, licence and retrieval date recorded (source README and `source.yaml`)
- [ ] No confidential, personal or security-sensitive information
- [ ] Tests and the full build run cleanly locally, and every error is fixed
- [ ] The item's descriptor (`dataset.yaml`, `analysis.yaml` or `infographic.yaml`) and README are updated
- [ ] Generated files were regenerated by the pipeline, not edited by hand
- [ ] Findings give the year and unit with each number, and state the limits
- [ ] Every figure has alt text that states the finding in plain words
- [ ] Figure checked at projector size and in greyscale (for infographics)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated for user-visible changes
- [ ] If this change answers a listed question or implements an idea, its status and related-work link in `docs/questions.md` are updated
- [ ] Accessibility checklist completed for new or changed figures ([docs/accessibility.md](../docs/accessibility.md#4-pre-publication-checklist))
